name: Employer Career Page Searcher

name: Professional Credential Researcher

name: Salary Evidence Researcher
description: Compares government statistics, employer disclosures, surveys, role levels, locations, and total-compensation caveats.

name: Industry Skill Demand Analyst

name: Internship and Graduate Program Searcher
description: Finds official student programs, eligibility, dates, location, requirements, and conversion opportunities.

name: Professional Association Searcher
description: Finds recognized associations, standards, events, directories, and educational resources.

name: Remote Work Legitimacy Verifier
description: Checks official domains, recruiter identity, fee requests, job duplication, and scam warnings.

name: Career Evidence Freshness Auditor
description: Checks role status, posting date, regional applicability, salary period, and source reliability.

name: Tender and Procurement Searcher
description: Finds official bidding notices, specifications, eligibility, deadlines, amendments, awards, and contact channels.

name: Grant Opportunity Researcher
description: Finds official funding calls, priorities, eligibility, amounts, dates, obligations, and application material.

name: Scholarship Opportunity Researcher
description: Finds verified scholarships, coverage, criteria, deadlines, service conditions, and official submission portals.

name: Competition and Award Searcher
description: Finds recognized contests, categories, rules, judging, dates, fees, rights, and prior winners.

name: Request for Proposal Analyzer
description: Extracts scope, deliverables, criteria, compliance items, schedule, budget signals, and submission method.

name: Procurement Amendment Tracker
description: Checks addenda, clarifications, deadline changes, cancellations, and revised documents.

name: Award and Contract Result Researcher
description: Finds official awards, values, suppliers, dates, and evaluation notices.

name: Eligibility Evidence Searcher
description: Finds exact geographic, organizational, financial, technical, and status requirements.

name: Opportunity Calendar Builder
description: Consolidates verified deadlines, lead times, documents, dependencies, and decision dates.

name: Opportunity Legitimacy Auditor
description: Checks official issuer, domain, fees, rights, privacy, conflicts, and scam indicators.

name: Market Landscape Mapper
description: Identifies organizations, offerings, segments, geographies, technologies, and customer groups from public evidence.

name: Competitor Product Researcher
description: Compares official features, positioning, pricing, integrations, customers, and release direction.

name: Strategic Movement Tracker
description: Monitors launches, hiring, partnerships, acquisitions, patents, filings, and geographic expansion.

name: Customer and Use-Case Researcher
description: Finds published case studies, reviews, contracts, testimonials, and implementation evidence.

name: Positioning and Messaging Analyzer
description: Compares public claims, target audiences, category language, proof points, and differentiation.

name: Partnership Network Researcher
description: Finds alliances, resellers, platform integrations, suppliers, investors, and ecosystem programs.

name: Competitive Hiring Signal Researcher
description: Uses public job postings to identify capabilities, regions, tools, and likely priorities cautiously.

name: Competitive Technology Stack Researcher
description: Finds disclosed frameworks, infrastructure, APIs, security claims, and engineering publications.

name: White-Space Evidence Finder
description: Identifies underserved needs and missing features from public comparisons and user evidence.

name: Competitive Intelligence Ethics Auditor
description: Uses lawful public sources, respects access limits, and separates evidence from speculation.

name: Claim Decomposition Fact Checker
description: Breaks a complex statement into separately verifiable entities, dates, numbers, causes, and quotations.

name: Original Source Tracer
description: Finds the earliest authoritative source behind a statistic, quote, image, chart, or repeated claim.

name: Date and Chronology Verifier
description: Checks publication, occurrence, update, access, and effective dates and resolves timeline confusion.

name: Number and Denominator Verifier
description: Checks units, baselines, population, percentage points, inflation, rounding, and source tables.

name: Quotation Context Verifier
description: Finds full surrounding text, speaker, date, audience, translation, and whether wording was altered.

name: Image and Video Context Verifier
description: Checks date, place, source, edit history, caption, and whether media was reused from another event.

name: Causal Claim Auditor
description: Checks whether evidence supports causation, association, prediction, or only temporal sequence.

name: Consensus and Dispute Mapper
description: Shows what is established, contested, uncertain, outdated, or unsupported and by whom.

name: Correction and Retraction Searcher
description: Checks retractions, expressions of concern, official corrections, debunks, and updated datasets.

name: Fact-Check Conclusion Calibrator
description: Uses supported, unsupported, misleading, outdated, disputed, or unverifiable labels with evidence and dates.

category: Source Quality, Bias, and Credibility Assessment
name: Source Authority Assessor
description: Evaluates authorship, institution, expertise, editorial process, primary access, and accountability.

category: Source Quality, Bias, and Credibility Assessment
name: Methodology Quality Reviewer
description: Checks sampling, measurement, controls, analysis, transparency, preregistration, and limitations.

category: Source Quality, Bias, and Credibility Assessment
name: Conflict and Funding Reviewer
description: Finds disclosed sponsorship, employment, advocacy, commercial interest, and competing interests.

category: Source Quality, Bias, and Credibility Assessment
name: Publication Integrity Checker
description: Checks peer review, corrections, retractions, predatory indicators, and journal or outlet transparency.

category: Source Quality, Bias, and Credibility Assessment
name: Bias and Framing Analyst
description: Examines selection, wording, omitted context, incentives, ideology, and asymmetric skepticism.

category: Source Quality, Bias, and Credibility Assessment
name: Source Independence Analyzer
description: Detects when multiple reports trace back to one press release, dataset, witness, or study.

category: Source Quality, Bias, and Credibility Assessment
name: Evidence Recency Assessor
description: Evaluates whether age matters and whether later versions or changes supersede the source.

category: Source Quality, Bias, and Credibility Assessment
name: Expertise Relevance Checker
description: Checks whether credentials and experience match the specific claim rather than a broad adjacent field.

category: Source Quality, Bias, and Credibility Assessment
name: Citation Support Auditor
description: Checks whether cited material actually supports the sentence and not merely the general topic.

category: Source Quality, Bias, and Credibility Assessment
name: Credibility Rating Calibrator
description: Produces transparent, claim-specific credibility judgments rather than permanent labels for whole sources.

name: Web Evidence Extractor
description: Captures relevant passages, fields, tables, dates, authors, links, and context from authorized pages.

name: Structured Research Schema Designer
description: Defines fields, types, identifiers, provenance, null meaning, and validation before collection.

name: Entity and Relationship Extractor
description: Identifies people, organizations, products, places, events, dates, and supported relationships.

name: Timeline Event Extractor
description: Captures dated actions, statements, publications, releases, and status changes with sources.

name: Table and List Normalizer
description: Converts visible structured data into consistent rows while preserving headers, units, notes, and source links.

name: Quotation and Passage Collector
description: Stores brief relevant quotations with exact source location and surrounding context.

name: Metadata Capture Specialist
description: Records title, creator, publisher, date, version, language, license, canonical URL, and access date.

name: Research Note Deduplicator
description: Merges repeated facts while preserving all independent sources and meaningful differences.

name: Evidence Tagging Specialist
description: Tags evidence by question, claim, source type, date, geography, confidence, and unresolved issue.

name: Extraction Quality Auditor
description: Checks omissions, truncation, field shifts, encoding, duplicates, and provenance before synthesis.

name: Citation Record Builder
description: Creates consistent source records with title, author, publisher, date, URL, version, and access information.

name: Claim-Level Citation Mapper
description: Attaches sources directly to the statements, numbers, and conclusions they support.

name: Research Search Log Manager
description: Records queries, systems, filters, dates, result decisions, and unresolved searches for reproducibility.

name: Source Snapshot Planner
description: Preserves lawful snapshots or archive references when public pages may change.

name: Dataset Provenance Recorder
description: Tracks dataset creator, release, method, license, download, transformation, and derived outputs.

name: Media Provenance Recorder
description: Tracks creator, original upload, date, caption, license, edits, and reuse permissions.

name: Citation Style Formatter
description: Formats sources in APA, MLA, Chicago, IEEE, legal, or user-specified styles without altering source facts.

name: Broken Citation Repairer
description: Finds corrected URLs, DOIs, archived pages, updated editions, and complete bibliographic details.

name: Citation Consistency Auditor
description: Checks duplicates, missing fields, uncited claims, unused references, and mismatched dates or authors.

name: Research Provenance Package Curator
description: Packages sources, notes, query logs, datasets, and limitations for handoff when requested.

name: Coverage Matrix Builder
description: Maps research questions against source types, time periods, regions, viewpoints, and evidence status.

name: Source Diversity Auditor
description: Checks balance across primary, academic, official, local, technical, community, and critical sources.

name: Temporal Coverage Auditor
description: Checks historical foundations, recent developments, revisions, and future-dated announcements.

name: Geographic Coverage Auditor
description: Checks local, national, regional, and international evidence according to the question.

name: Stakeholder Coverage Auditor
description: Checks affected users, experts, institutions, critics, implementers, and decision-makers.

name: Missing Primary Evidence Detector
description: Finds conclusions supported only by summaries, reposts, or commentary and plans original- source searches.

name: Search Saturation Analyst
description: Measures whether new searches produce genuinely new evidence or only repeated information.

name: Long-Tail Source Finder
description: Searches niche repositories, local archives, specialist forums, conference material, and less- indexed sources.

name: Known-Unknown Register
description: Maintains unresolved questions, inaccessible sources, contradictory evidence, and reasons for stopping.

name: Coverage Completion Gatekeeper
description: Allows completion only when the declared scope is covered or remaining gaps are explicitly reported.

name: Evidence Synthesis Architect
description: Organizes findings by question, claim, chronology, mechanism, theme, or decision rather than by source order.

name: Agreement and Disagreement Synthesizer
description: Separates consensus, partial agreement, definitional conflict, method differences, and unresolved dispute.

name: Comparative Research Analyst
description: Compares entities under common criteria, aligned dates, equivalent units, and transparent missing data.

name: Research Theme Analyst
description: Identifies recurring concepts, relationships, evidence clusters, and meaningful exceptions.

name: Causal Mechanism Synthesizer
description: Combines evidence about how and why an outcome occurs while preserving alternative explanations.

name: Quantitative Evidence Integrator
description: Combines numbers only when definitions, populations, periods, units, and methods are compatible.

name: Qualitative Evidence Integrator
description: Synthesizes interviews, observations, texts, and case studies without erasing context or variation.

name: Source Conflict Explainer
description: Explains disagreement through time, definitions, population, method, incentives, access, or error.

name: Research-to-Decision Translator
description: Converts evidence into options, implications, risks, and next actions without exceeding what sources support.

name: Synthesis Integrity Auditor
description: Checks that summaries preserve source meaning, uncertainty, attribution, and important counterevidence.

name: Scheduled Search Monitor
description: Runs bounded recurring searches for updates, releases, policy changes, prices, publications, or incidents.

name: Webpage Change Detector
description: Tracks meaningful text, metadata, link, table, policy, or version changes while suppressing layout noise.

name: Feed and Newsletter Monitor
description: Collects RSS, Atom, mailing-list, release, and publication updates with deduplication.

name: Repository Release Watcher
description: Monitors tags, releases, changelogs, advisories, issues, and documentation updates.

name: Citation Alert Designer
description: Tracks new works citing a key paper, patent, standard, or report where supported.

name: Dataset Update Monitor
description: Detects new releases, revised values, schema changes, licenses, and methodology updates.

name: News and Event Alert Router
description: Routes verified updates by topic, urgency, geography, source authority, and user interest.

name: Monitoring Noise Reducer
description: Clusters duplicates, distinguishes substantive changes, and suppresses repeated low-value alerts.

name: Monitor Failure Tester
description: Checks credentials, rate limits, missed updates, false positives, schedule drift, and alert delivery.

name: Research Watchlist Manager
description: Maintains entities, queries, sources, indicators, review dates, and retirement rules for ongoing research.

category: Privacy, Ethics, Rights, and Safe Search
name: Privacy-Preserving Query Designer
description: Avoids placing confidential, personal, or tenant-derived information into public search queries.

category: Privacy, Ethics, Rights, and Safe Search
name: Personal Data Minimization Researcher
description: Collects only necessary public information and avoids aggregating sensitive details without legitimate need.

category: Privacy, Ethics, Rights, and Safe Search
name: Terms and Access Policy Reviewer
description: Checks platform terms, robots directives, API policies, licensing, and technical access limits before automation.

category: Privacy, Ethics, Rights, and Safe Search
name: Copyright-Aware Researcher
description: Uses summaries and brief quotations, records rights, and avoids reproducing protected works excessively.

category: Privacy, Ethics, Rights, and Safe Search
name: Sensitive Community Research Reviewer
description: Checks potential harm, stigmatization, exposure, consent, and context when researching vulnerable groups.

category: Privacy, Ethics, Rights, and Safe Search
name: Doxxing and Targeting Prevention Gatekeeper
description: Rejects unnecessary collection or disclosure of private identifying, location, or contact information.

category: Privacy, Ethics, Rights, and Safe Search
name: Responsible Archive Use Reviewer
description: Balances historical access, privacy, takedown context, and lawful public-interest use.

category: Privacy, Ethics, Rights, and Safe Search
name: Research Conflict-of-Interest Discloser
description: Reports material sponsorship, advocacy, commercial interest, and researcher relationships when relevant.

category: Privacy, Ethics, Rights, and Safe Search
name: Ethical Search Scope Auditor
description: Checks that the research method is proportionate, lawful, necessary, and aligned with the user’s legitimate purpose.

category: Privacy, Ethics, Rights, and Safe Search
name: Sensitive Findings Handoff Planner
description: Uses redaction, access controls, minimum detail, and appropriate escalation for sensitive results.

name: Requirement Coverage Tester
description: Checks every requested topic, entity, date, source class, output, and constraint against the finished research.

name: Source Reopen Tester
description: Reopens cited pages and confirms that links, passages, dates, and claims still match.

name: Independent Claim Cross-Checker
description: Uses alternate sources or methods to verify high-impact claims and important numbers.

name: Boundary Search Tester
description: Checks alternate spellings, languages, older dates, local sources, and contrary viewpoints for missed evidence.

name: Citation Accuracy Tester
description: Confirms every citation supports the nearby sentence and points to the correct source.

name: Freshness Verification Tester
description: Rechecks time-sensitive facts immediately before delivery using primary or authoritative sources.

name: Research Reproducibility Tester
description: Reruns representative queries and verifies that the search log can recover the core evidence.

name: Contradiction Resolution Tester
description: Checks whether unresolved conflicts are visible and whether the synthesis represents competing evidence fairly.

name: Handoff Usability Tester
description: Confirms the recipient can locate sources, understand conclusions, inspect limitations, and continue the research.

name: Final Research Integrity Gatekeeper
description: Blocks completion when material claims are unsupported, sources are misrepresented, or required coverage is missing.

name: Universal Search Task Framer
description: Combines prompt interpretation, scope, freshness, privacy, source needs, and completion tests.

name: Multi-Engine Search Orchestrator
description: Routes complementary queries across general search, official sites, repositories, literature databases, archives, and local sources.

name: Deep Traversal Research Director
description: Coordinates scrolling, pagination, link following, site maps, archives, and bounded long-tail discovery.

name: Evidence Acquisition Steward
description: Collects only relevant facts, passages, datasets, media, and metadata with provenance.

name: Search Breadth and Depth Balancer
description: Allocates effort across wide discovery, focused verification, counterevidence, and diminishing returns.

name: Nothing-Material-Missed Controller
description: Uses coverage matrices, alternate terms, source diversity, date ranges, languages, and gap checks to reduce blind spots.

name: Adaptive Query Learning Controller
description: Updates terms, filters, engines, and source priorities based on observed results and failed searches.

name: Whole-Research Verification Architect
description: Links questions and conclusions to source, contradiction, freshness, coverage, and handoff checks.

name: Search Resume and Continuity Manager
description: Saves queries, sources, decisions, gaps, and next actions so interrupted research can continue cleanly.

name: Ultimate Searcher Coordinator
description: Integrates discovery, traversal, extraction, verification, synthesis, monitoring, ethics, and clean delivery into one governed capability.
